book_description_html:
🌟 Welcome to the Masterclass Classroom of Mrs. B! 🌟

Step inside a vibrant, heartwarming world where early literacy, emotional self-regulation, and cultural pride come alive! Created by veteran educator Mrs. B (Faustine B. Meralus, M.Ed. ESOL) and visionary artist Dave Meralus, Learn With Mrs. B is the ultimate 88-page single-sided coloring and activity masterclass designed for early learners, bilingual diaspora families, and young scholars.

📚 What Makes This Book Unique?

  • Trilingual Phonics & Vocabulary: Every lesson bridges English, Haitian Creole (Kreyòl Ayisyen), and Spanish (Español) with clear phonetic pronunciation guides.
  • Wynn Capit Kinesthetic Swatch System: Color-coded swatch bubbles [ ○ ] build motor-visual memory for fast vocabulary retention.
  • Full 26-Letter Alphabet Mastery: Every letter from A to Z is brought to life across 8 narrative storybook units.
  • Helen Elliston 54-Color Swatch Lab: Includes a dedicated color-testing matrix to master blending, shading, and burnishing.
  • Single-Sided with Protective Bleed Guards: Exactly 44 high-contrast recto master plates paired with 44 patterned verso bleed guards—zero marker bleed-through!
  • Authentic Family Heritage & Representation: Rooted in the rich cultural legacy of the Meralus family, celebrating multi-generational love, graduation honors, and big dreams.

🎓 Perfect For:

Pre-K, Kindergarten, 1st & 2nd Grade students, ESL/ESOL classrooms, bilingual households, and homeschooling families!
